lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你的中文怎麼進步得這麼快？你來臺灣才一年吧？
lines.simplified: 你的中文怎么进步得这么快？你来台湾才一年吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de Zhōngwén zěnme jìnbù de zhème kuài? Nǐ lái Táiwān cái yì nián ba?
lines.english: How has your Chinese improved so fast? You've only been in Taiwan a year, right?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這就要從我的室友說起了。他是臺灣人，想練英文，所以我們說好在家只說中文，出門才說英文。
lines.simplified: 这就要从我的室友说起了。他是台湾人，想练英文，所以我们说好在家只说中文，出门才说英文。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiù yào cóng wǒ de shìyǒu shuō qǐ le. Tā shì Táiwān rén, xiǎng liàn Yīngwén, suǒyǐ wǒmen shuō hǎo zài jiā zhǐ shuō Zhōngwén, chūmén cái shuō Yīngwén.
lines.english: For that I have to start with my roommate. He's Taiwanese and wants to practise English, so we agreed to speak only Chinese at home and English only when we go out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個辦法不錯啊。那他的英文也變好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 这个办法不错啊。那他的英文也变好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ búcuò a. Nà tā de Yīngwén yě biàn hǎo le ma?
lines.english: That's a good idea. So has his English got better too?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有。他每天下課就回家打電腦遊戲，週末也不太出門，我們很少一起出去。
lines.simplified: 没有。他每天下课就回家打电脑游戏，周末也不太出门，我们很少一起出去。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Tā měi tiān xiàkè jiù huíjiā dǎ diànnǎo yóuxì, zhōumò yě bú tài chūmén, wǒmen hěn shǎo yìqǐ chūqù.
lines.english: No. Every day after class he goes home and plays computer games, he hardly goes out at weekends either, so we seldom go out together.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 為什麼這個辦法對男的比較有用？
prompt.simplified: 为什么这个办法对男的比较有用？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme zhège bànfǎ duì nán de bǐjiào yǒuyòng?
prompt.english: Why has this arrangement helped the man more than his roommate?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們在一起的時候多數都在家
choices.simplified: 他们在一起的时候多数都在家
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài yìqǐ de shíhòu duōshù dōu zài jiā.
choices.english: When they are together, they are mostly at home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 室友下課以後都在練英文
choices.simplified: 室友下课以后都在练英文
choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu xiàkè yǐhòu dōu zài liàn Yīngwén.
choices.english: The roommate practises English after class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們出門的時候也說中文
choices.simplified: 他们出门的时候也说中文
choices.pinyin: Tāmen chūmén de shíhòu yě shuō Zhōngwén.
choices.english: They speak Chinese when they go out too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想練中文的其實是室友
choices.simplified: 想练中文的其实是室友
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng liàn Zhōngwén de qíshí shì shìyǒu.
choices.english: It is actually the roommate who wants to practise Chinese.

questions.why: Put the deal (Chinese at home, English only 出門) together with the last turn (the roommate stays home, 很少一起出去): nearly all their time together is spent at home, in Chinese, which helps the man, not the roommate. The roommate plays games after class, they speak English outside, and it is the man who wants Chinese.

focus.zh: （這）就要從……說起了；兩句合起來看
focus.en: to explain, start from…; combining two turns

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你把箱子都拿出來，在找什麼？
lines.simplified: 你把箱子都拿出来，在找什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ xiāngzi dōu ná chūlái, zài zhǎo shénme?
lines.english: You've taken all the boxes out. What are you looking for?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我女朋友想用我們第一次約會的電影票，做一張七夕卡片。我記得收在箱子裡，可是不知道是哪一個。
lines.simplified: 我女朋友想用我们第一次约会的电影票，做一张七夕卡片。我记得收在箱子里，可是不知道是哪一个。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ nǚpéngyǒu xiǎng yòng wǒmen dì yī cì yuēhuì de diànyǐng piào, zuò yì zhāng Qīxī kǎpiàn. Wǒ jìde shōu zài xiāngzi lǐ, kěshì bù zhīdào shì nǎ yí ge.
lines.english: My girlfriend wants to use the movie tickets from our first date to make a Qixi card. I remember putting them away in a box, but I don't know which one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你這三年的東西都在這裡。最下面那個是你剛搬來時放的，要找舊東西，得先從那個找起。
lines.simplified: 你这三年的东西都在这里。最下面那个是你刚搬来时放的，要找旧东西，得先从那个找起。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhè sān nián de dōngxi dōu zài zhèlǐ. Zuì xiàmiàn nàge shì nǐ gāng bān lái shí fàng de, yào zhǎo jiù dōngxi, děi xiān cóng nàge zhǎo qǐ.
lines.english: Three years of your things are all here. The bottom one is what you packed when you first moved in. To find old things, you'd have to start with that one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是我們是去年才認識的。
lines.simplified: 可是我们是去年才认识的。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒmen shì qùnián cái rènshì de.
lines.english: But we only met last year.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那就別從下面找了，先打開最上面那個吧。
lines.simplified: 那就别从下面找了，先打开最上面那个吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù bié cóng xiàmiàn zhǎo le, xiān dǎkāi zuì shàngmiàn nàge ba.
lines.english: Then don't start from the bottom. Open the top one first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後為什麼要男的先找最上面的箱子？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后为什么要男的先找最上面的箱子？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu wèishénme yào nán de xiān zhǎo zuì shàngmiàn de xiāngzi?
prompt.english: Why does the woman finally tell the man to search the top box first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們第一次約會是三年前
choices.simplified: 他们第一次约会是三年前
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dì yī cì yuēhuì shì sān nián qián.
choices.english: Their first date was three years ago.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 電影票是比較晚才收起來的
choices.simplified: 电影票是比较晚才收起来的
choices.pinyin: Diànyǐng piào shì bǐjiào wǎn cái shōu qǐlái de.
choices.english: The tickets were put away later.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女朋友記得票放在上面
choices.simplified: 女朋友记得票放在上面
choices.pinyin: Nǚpéngyǒu jìde piào fàng zài shàngmiàn.
choices.english: His girlfriend remembers the tickets are on top.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 最下面的箱子是女朋友的
choices.simplified: 最下面的箱子是女朋友的
choices.pinyin: Zuì xiàmiàn de xiāngzi shì nǚpéngyǒu de.
choices.english: The bottom box is his girlfriend's.

questions.why: The bottom box holds what he packed three years ago, but they only met 去年, so the tickets went in later, near the top. Three years is how long he has lived there, not when they met; she never says where the girlfriend thinks they are; and all the boxes are his.

focus.en: start looking from…; drawing a conclusion

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是說電腦壞了嗎？報告怎麼還交得出來？
lines.simplified: 你不是说电脑坏了吗？报告怎么还交得出来？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō diànnǎo huài le ma? Bàogào zěnme hái jiāo de chūlái?
lines.english: Didn't you say your computer broke? How could you still hand in your report?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 修電腦的人說，裡面的東西都拿不出來了。幸虧我每寫完一段就上傳到雲端，要不然三個星期都白寫了。
lines.simplified: 修电脑的人说，里面的东西都拿不出来了。幸亏我每写完一段就上传到云端，要不然三个星期都白写了。
lines.pinyin: Xiū diànnǎo de rén shuō, lǐmiàn de dōngxi dōu ná bù chūlái le. Xìngkuī wǒ měi xiě wán yí duàn jiù shàngchuán dào yúnduān, yàobùrán sān ge xīngqí dōu bái xiě le.
lines.english: The repair guy says nothing inside can be recovered. Luckily I uploaded to the cloud every time I finished a section; otherwise three weeks of writing would have been for nothing.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你今天怎麼看起來還這麼累？
lines.simplified: 那你今天怎么看起来还这么累？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ jīntiān zěnme kàn qǐlái hái zhème lèi?
lines.english: Then why do you still look so tired today?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 最後那一段是電腦壞掉那天晚上寫的，還沒上傳，我只好昨天晚上再寫一次。
lines.simplified: 最后那一段是电脑坏掉那天晚上写的，还没上传，我只好昨天晚上再写一次。
lines.pinyin: Zuìhòu nà yí duàn shì diànnǎo huài diào nà tiān wǎnshàng xiě de, hái méi shàngchuán, wǒ zhǐhǎo zuótiān wǎnshàng zài xiě yí cì.
lines.english: The last section I wrote the night the computer died, and it wasn't uploaded yet, so I had to write it again last night.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的今天為什麼看起來還是很累？
prompt.simplified: 男的今天为什么看起来还是很累？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jīntiān wèishénme kàn qǐlái háishì hěn lèi?
prompt.english: Why does the man still look tired today?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 三個星期寫的都得重新寫
choices.simplified: 三个星期写的都得重新写
choices.pinyin: Sān ge xīngqí xiě de dōu děi chóngxīn xiě.
choices.english: Everything from three weeks had to be rewritten.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 雲端上的東西也拿不出來了
choices.simplified: 云端上的东西也拿不出来了
choices.pinyin: Yúnduān shàng de dōngxi yě ná bù chūlái le.
choices.english: Nothing could be got out of the cloud either.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 最後那段不見了，得重新寫
choices.simplified: 最后那段不见了，得重新写
choices.pinyin: Zuìhòu nà duàn bú jiàn le, děi chóngxīn xiě.
choices.english: The last section was lost and he had to write it again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 修電腦的人要他等三個星期
choices.simplified: 修电脑的人要他等三个星期
choices.pinyin: Xiū diànnǎo de rén yào tā děng sān ge xīngqí.
choices.english: The repair guy told him to wait three weeks.

questions.why: 幸虧 shows the cloud saved every section he had uploaded; the last turn gives the gap: the section written the night the computer died was not up yet, so he rewrote it last night. Losing all three weeks is only what follows 要不然, what would have happened without the cloud; it is the computer, not the cloud, that nothing comes out of; and three weeks is how long he had been writing.

focus.zh: 幸虧……，要不然……；兩句合起來看

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳要送男朋友的那個布包，做好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你要送男朋友的那个布包，做好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yào sòng nánpéngyǒu de nàge bù bāo, zuò hǎo le ma?
lines.english: The cloth bag you're giving your boyfriend: is it finished?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 做好了，可是昨天差一點就不見了。我用手機叫計程車回家，下車的時候忘了拿。
lines.simplified: 做好了，可是昨天差一点就不见了。我用手机叫计程车回家，下车的时候忘了拿。
lines.pinyin: Zuò hǎo le, kěshì zuótiān chà yìdiǎn jiù bú jiàn le. Wǒ yòng shǒujī jiào jìchéngchē huíjiā, xià chē de shíhòu wàng le ná.
lines.english: It's done, but yesterday I nearly lost it. I called a taxi home on my phone and forgot to take it when I got out.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn?
lines.english: So what did you do?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 幸虧手機上有司機的電話，我馬上打給他，他晚上就幫我送回來了，要不然就得從頭再做一個。後天就是七夕，一定來不及。
lines.simplified: 幸亏手机上有司机的电话，我马上打给他，他晚上就帮我送回来了，要不然就得从头再做一个。后天就是七夕，一定来不及。
lines.pinyin: Xìngkuī shǒujī shàng yǒu sījī de diànhuà, wǒ mǎshàng dǎ gěi tā, tā wǎnshàng jiù bāng wǒ sòng huílái le, yàobùrán jiù děi cóngtóu zài zuò yí ge. Hòutiān jiù shì Qīxī, yídìng láibùjí.
lines.english: Luckily the driver's number was on my phone. I called him straight away and he brought it back that evening; otherwise I'd have had to make another from scratch. Qixi is the day after tomorrow; I'd never have made it in time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「一定來不及」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「一定来不及」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "yídìng láibùjí", shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by "I'd never have made it in time"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 司機要很晚才能送回來
choices.simplified: 司机要很晚才能送回来
choices.pinyin: Sījī yào hěn wǎn cái néng sòng huílái.
choices.english: The driver can only bring it back very late.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她沒辦法馬上找到司機
choices.simplified: 她没办法马上找到司机
choices.pinyin: Tā méi bànfǎ mǎshàng zhǎodào sījī.
choices.english: She can't reach the driver straight away.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 七夕那天趕不上跟男朋友見面
choices.simplified: 七夕那天赶不上跟男朋友见面
choices.pinyin: Qīxī nà tiān gǎn bú shàng gēn nánpéngyǒu jiànmiàn.
choices.english: She won't make it to meet her boyfriend on Qixi.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要是重做，七夕以前做不完
choices.simplified: 要是重做，七夕以前做不完
choices.pinyin: Yàoshì chóng zuò, Qīxī yǐqián zuò bù wán.
choices.english: If she had to make it again, she couldn't finish before Qixi.

questions.why: 一定來不及 belongs to the 要不然 part: had the driver not brought the bag back, she would have had to make a new one, and with Qixi only two days off it could not be done. In fact the driver brought it that same evening, she reached him at once because his number was on her phone, and nothing is said about missing the meeting itself.

focus.zh: 幸虧……，要不然……；假設的結果
focus.en: luckily…, otherwise…; what would have happened

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是說要學開車嗎？怎麼買了一輛機車？
lines.simplified: 你不是说要学开车吗？怎么买了一辆机车？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō yào xué kāichē ma? Zěnme mǎi le yí liàng jīchē?
lines.english: Didn't you say you were going to learn to drive? Why have you bought a motorcycle?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 騎機車既方便又便宜，找地方停也很容易。我覺得不用學開車了。
lines.simplified: 骑机车既方便又便宜，找地方停也很容易。我觉得不用学开车了。
lines.pinyin: Qí jīchē jì fāngbiàn yòu piányí, zhǎo dìfāng tíng yě hěn róngyì. Wǒ juéde búyòng xué kāichē le.
lines.english: A motorcycle is both convenient and cheap, and it's easy to find somewhere to park. I don't think I need to learn to drive.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是你下個月就要搬到山上那個學校旁邊了，那裡常常下雨，騎機車多危險啊！
lines.simplified: 可是你下个月就要搬到山上那个学校旁边了，那里常常下雨，骑机车多危险啊！
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ xià ge yuè jiù yào bān dào shān shàng nàge xuéxiào pángbiān le, nàlǐ chángcháng xiàyǔ, qí jīchē duō wéixiǎn a!
lines.english: But next month you're moving next to that school up in the mountains. It rains a lot there. Riding a motorcycle is so dangerous!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就是下大雨，我也不怕。穿上雨衣，騎慢一點就好了。
lines.simplified: 就是下大雨，我也不怕。穿上雨衣，骑慢一点就好了。
lines.pinyin: Jiùshì xià dà yǔ, wǒ yě bú pà. Chuān shàng yǔyī, qí màn yìdiǎn jiù hǎo le.
lines.english: Even if it pours, I'm not afraid. I'll put on a raincoat and ride a bit slower.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後的意思是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后的意思是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu de yìsi shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man mean in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bānjiā yǐhòu zài qù xué kāichē.
choices.english: He'll learn to drive after he moves.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下大雨的時候就不騎了
choices.simplified: 下大雨的时候就不骑了
choices.pinyin: Xià dà yǔ de shíhòu jiù bù qí le.
choices.english: He won't ride when it pours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 雨再大也還是要騎機車
choices.simplified: 雨再大也还是要骑机车
choices.pinyin: Yǔ zài dà yě háishì yào qí jīchē.
choices.english: However hard it rains, he will still ride.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shān shàng de yǔ méiyǒu nàme duō.
choices.english: It doesn't rain that much in the mountains.

questions.why: 就是下大雨，我也不怕 answers her worry about rain: even then he will keep riding, with a raincoat. Someone who misses 就是……也 hears "when it pours I won't ride"; he said he doesn't need to learn to drive at all; and he never argues it rains less.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳們店裡新來的那個店員，做得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你们店里新来的那个店员，做得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen diàn lǐ xīn lái de nàge diànyuán, zuò de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How is the new shop assistant at your shop doing?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她才來一個星期，可是客人問什麼，她都能回答。
lines.simplified: 她才来一个星期，可是客人问什么，她都能回答。
lines.pinyin: Tā cái lái yí ge xīngqí, kěshì kèrén wèn shénme, tā dōu néng huídá.
lines.english: She's only been here a week, but she can answer whatever customers ask.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳應該很放心了吧？
lines.simplified: 那你应该很放心了吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ yīnggāi hěn fàngxīn le ba?
lines.english: So you must feel quite relieved?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還好。只是她太謙虛了，客人說她做得很好，她往往說「沒有啦，我做得不好」，客人反而不知道要說什麼。
lines.simplified: 还好。只是她太谦虚了，客人说她做得很好，她往往说「没有啦，我做得不好」，客人反而不知道要说什么。
lines.pinyin: Hái hǎo. Zhǐshì tā tài qiānxū le, kèrén shuō tā zuò de hěn hǎo, tā wǎngwǎng shuō "Méiyǒu la, wǒ zuò de bù hǎo", kèrén fǎn'ér bù zhīdào yào shuō shénme.
lines.english: More or less. It's just that she's too modest. When customers say she's doing well, she usually says, "Oh no, I'm not," and then the customers don't know what to say.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的問她是不是很放心，女的說「還好」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的问她是不是很放心，女的说「还好」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèn tā shì bú shì hěn fàngxīn, nǚ de shuō "hái hǎo", shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: When the man asks if she feels relieved, what does the woman mean by "more or less"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店員才來，還不能讓人放心
choices.simplified: 店员才来，还不能让人放心
choices.pinyin: Diànyuán cái lái, hái bù néng ràng rén fàngxīn.
choices.english: The assistant is too new to be trusted yet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店員做得不錯，只是有一點要改
choices.simplified: 店员做得不错，只是有一点要改
choices.pinyin: Diànyuán zuò de búcuò, zhǐshì yǒu yìdiǎn yào gǎi.
choices.english: The assistant does well, but one thing needs to change.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店員往往說自己做得很好
choices.simplified: 店员往往说自己做得很好
choices.pinyin: Diànyuán wǎngwǎng shuō zìjǐ zuò de hěn hǎo.
choices.english: The assistant usually says she is doing well.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 客人覺得店員不夠客氣
choices.simplified: 客人觉得店员不够客气
choices.pinyin: Kèrén juéde diànyuán bú gòu kèqì.
choices.english: Customers find the assistant not polite enough.

questions.why: 還好 is a half-yes: she can answer everything, 只是 when praised she 往往 runs herself down and leaves customers stuck. Her worry is not that she is new; it is the customers who say she does well, while she says she doesn't; and the trouble is too much modesty, not too little politeness.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳最近一下課就回宿舍，在忙什麼？
lines.simplified: 你最近一下课就回宿舍，在忙什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn yí xiàkè jiù huí sùshè, zài máng shénme?
lines.english: Lately you go straight back to the dorm after class. What are you busy with?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我在畫一張畫，要在七夕寄給我男朋友。他在國外念書，我想把我們第一次約會的那條河畫給他看。
lines.simplified: 我在画一张画，要在七夕寄给我男朋友。他在国外念书，我想把我们第一次约会的那条河画给他看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài huà yì zhāng huà, yào zài Qīxī jì gěi wǒ nánpéngyǒu. Tā zài guówài niànshū, wǒ xiǎng bǎ wǒmen dì yī cì yuēhuì de nà tiáo hé huà gěi tā kàn.
lines.english: I'm painting a picture to send my boyfriend for Qixi. He's studying abroad, and I want to paint the river where we had our first date for him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好浪漫啊！畫得怎麼樣了？
lines.simplified: 好浪漫啊！画得怎么样了？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo làngmàn a! Huà de zěnmeyàng le?
lines.english: How romantic! How is it going?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 別提了。我按照網路上的影片畫，可是影片講得太快，我常常畫錯，只好重新畫。
lines.simplified: 别提了。我按照网路上的影片画，可是影片讲得太快，我常常画错，只好重新画。
lines.pinyin: Bié tí le. Wǒ ànzhào wǎnglù shàng de yǐngpiàn huà, kěshì yǐngpiàn jiǎng de tài kuài, wǒ chángcháng huà cuò, zhǐhǎo chóngxīn huà.
lines.english: Don't ask. I'm following an online video, but it explains things too fast. I keep making mistakes and have to start again.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 畫了多久了？
lines.simplified: 画了多久了？
lines.pinyin: Huà le duōjiǔ le?
lines.english: How long have you been at it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 兩個星期了，連河都還沒畫好。我真的快畫不下去了。
lines.simplified: 两个星期了，连河都还没画好。我真的快画不下去了。
lines.pinyin: Liǎng ge xīngqí le, lián hé dōu hái méi huà hǎo. Wǒ zhēn de kuài huà bú xiàqù le.
lines.english: Two weeks, and I haven't even finished the river. I really can't keep going much longer.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我媽媽是教畫畫的老師。這個週末我回家，妳跟我一起去，讓她教妳吧。
lines.simplified: 我妈妈是教画画的老师。这个周末我回家，你跟我一起去，让她教你吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ māma shì jiāo huàhuà de lǎoshī. Zhège zhōumò wǒ huíjiā, nǐ gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù, ràng tā jiāo nǐ ba.
lines.english: My mom teaches painting. I'm going home this weekend. Come with me and let her teach you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 太好了！那我把畫了一半的那張帶去，請她看看哪裡有問題。
lines.simplified: 太好了！那我把画了一半的那张带去，请她看看哪里有问题。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Nà wǒ bǎ huà le yíbàn de nà zhāng dài qù, qǐng tā kànkan nǎlǐ yǒu wèntí.
lines.english: Great! Then I'll bring the half-finished one and ask her to see what's wrong.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的那張畫現在畫得怎麼樣了？
prompt.simplified: 女的那张画现在画得怎么样了？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de nà zhāng huà xiànzài huà de zěnmeyàng le?
prompt.english: How far along is the woman's picture now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hé yǐjīng huà hǎo le.
choices.english: The river is already done.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǐjīng jì dào guówài le.
choices.english: It has already been sent abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ chà zuìhòu yìdiǎn le.
choices.english: Only the last bit is left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái yǒu hěn duō dìfāng méi huà wán.
choices.english: Much of it is still unfinished.

questions.why: After two weeks 連河都還沒畫好, and at the end she calls it 畫了一半: about half is left. The river is exactly what is not done, she will mail it for Qixi, and half is far from "only the last bit".

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼說快畫不下去了？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么说快画不下去了？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme shuō kuài huà bú xiàqù le?
prompt.english: Why does the woman say she can hardly keep going?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǐngpiàn tài cháng, chángcháng kàn bù wán.
choices.english: The video is too long to finish.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 七夕就要到了，怕來不及
choices.simplified: 七夕就要到了，怕来不及
choices.pinyin: Qīxī jiù yào dào le, pà láibùjí.
choices.english: Qixi is coming and she fears she won't finish.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在宿舍沒有時間可以畫
choices.simplified: 在宿舍没有时间可以画
choices.pinyin: Zài sùshè méiyǒu shíjiān kěyǐ huà.
choices.english: She has no time to paint in the dorm.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 一直重來，花了很多時間
choices.simplified: 一直重来，花了很多时间
choices.pinyin: Yìzhí chónglái, huā le hěn duō shíjiān.
choices.english: She keeps starting over and it has taken ages.

questions.why: 畫不下去 means she can hardly go on, and two turns explain it: following the video (按照影片) she keeps getting it wrong and starting again, and after two weeks the river is still not done. The video is too fast, not too long; nobody mentions running out of time; and the dorm is exactly where she goes to paint.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽了男的說的話以後，女的心情有什麼改變？
prompt.simplified: 听了男的说的话以后，女的心情有什么改变？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng le nán de shuō de huà yǐhòu, nǚ de xīnqíng yǒu shénme gǎibiàn?
prompt.english: How does the woman's mood change after the man's offer?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來差一點不畫了，現在又有希望
choices.simplified: 本来差一点不画了，现在又有希望
choices.pinyin: Běnlái chà yìdiǎn bú huà le, xiànzài yòu yǒu xīwàng.
choices.english: She was about to give up and now has hope again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來想自己畫，現在要請人畫
choices.simplified: 本来想自己画，现在要请人画
choices.pinyin: Běnlái xiǎng zìjǐ huà, xiànzài yào qǐng rén huà.
choices.english: She meant to paint it herself and now will have someone else paint it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來要寄給他，現在想親手送
choices.simplified: 本来要寄给他，现在想亲手送
choices.pinyin: Běnlái yào jì gěi tā, xiànzài xiǎng qīnshǒu sòng.
choices.english: She meant to mail it and now wants to hand it over herself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來覺得很難，現在覺得容易
choices.simplified: 本来觉得很难，现在觉得容易
choices.pinyin: Běnlái juéde hěn nán, xiànzài juéde róngyì.
choices.english: She found it hard and now finds it easy.

questions.why: Before the offer she says 快畫不下去了; after it she says 太好了 and will take the half-done picture to his mother for advice: she has hope again. His mother will only look at it, she still paints it herself; nothing changes about mailing it; and getting help does not make it easy, it gives her a way on.

focus.en: a change in the speaker's attitude

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們訂的是七點，現在都七點二十了，怎麼還沒有位子？
lines.simplified: 我们订的是七点，现在都七点二十了，怎么还没有位子？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen dìng de shì qī diǎn, xiànzài dōu qī diǎn èrshí le, zěnme hái méiyǒu wèizi?
lines.english: We booked for seven. It's already twenty past. Why is there still no table?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我去問了。今天是七夕，人特別多，訂位只留十分鐘，過了就按照客人到的時間安排位子。
lines.simplified: 我去问了。今天是七夕，人特别多，订位只留十分钟，过了就按照客人到的时间安排位子。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qù wèn le. Jīntiān shì Qīxī, rén tèbié duō, dìngwèi zhǐ liú shí fēnzhōng, guò le jiù ànzhào kèrén dào de shíjiān ānpái wèizi.
lines.english: I went and asked. It's Qixi today and it's extra busy. A booking is only held for ten minutes; after that they seat people in the order they arrive.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是我們有訂位啊！
lines.simplified: 可是我们有订位啊！
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒmen yǒu dìngwèi a!
lines.english: But we booked!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們晚到了十五分鐘，前面還有五組人在等。
lines.simplified: 我们晚到了十五分钟，前面还有五组人在等。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎn dào le shíwǔ fēnzhōng, qiánmiàn hái yǒu wǔ zǔ rén zài děng.
lines.english: We got here fifteen minutes late, so there are still five groups waiting ahead of us.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 都是你，在路上買花買那麼久。
lines.simplified: 都是你，在路上买花买那么久。
lines.pinyin: Dōu shì nǐ, zài lù shàng mǎi huā mǎi nàme jiǔ.
lines.english: It's all your fault for taking so long buying flowers on the way.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是我不好。服務生還說，今天每組只能吃一個半小時，裡面的客人大概要八點才會走。
lines.simplified: 是我不好。服务生还说，今天每组只能吃一个半小时，里面的客人大概要八点才会走。
lines.pinyin: Shì wǒ bù hǎo. Fúwùshēng hái shuō, jīntiān měi zǔ zhǐ néng chī yí ge bàn xiǎoshí, lǐmiàn de kèrén dàgài yào bā diǎn cái huì zǒu.
lines.english: My fault. The waiter also said each group only gets an hour and a half today, so the diners inside probably won't leave until eight.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那再等下去，九點的電影就來不及看了。
lines.simplified: 那再等下去，九点的电影就来不及看了。
lines.pinyin: Nà zài děng xiàqù, jiǔ diǎn de diànyǐng jiù láibùjí kàn le.
lines.english: Then if we keep waiting, we won't make the nine o'clock movie.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們先去看電影吧。電影院旁邊有夜市，看完再去吃小吃。
lines.simplified: 那我们先去看电影吧。电影院旁边有夜市，看完再去吃小吃。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xiān qù kàn diànyǐng ba. Diànyǐngyuàn pángbiān yǒu yèshì, kàn wán zài qù chī xiǎochī.
lines.english: Then let's go to the movie first. There's a night market next to the cinema; we can eat snacks there afterwards.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧。不過這些花你自己拿著。
lines.simplified: 好吧。不过这些花你自己拿着。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Búguò zhèxiē huā nǐ zìjǐ názhe.
lines.english: Fine. But you can carry these flowers yourself.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼還沒有位子？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么还没有位子？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme hái méiyǒu wèizi?
prompt.english: Why don't they have a table yet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們訂的是八點的位子
choices.simplified: 他们订的是八点的位子
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dìng de shì bā diǎn de wèizi.
choices.english: They booked a table for eight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 前面五組都比他們早訂位
choices.simplified: 前面五组都比他们早订位
choices.pinyin: Qiánmiàn wǔ zǔ dōu bǐ tāmen zǎo dìngwèi.
choices.english: The five groups ahead booked earlier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 到的時候已經過了留位子的時間
choices.simplified: 到的时候已经过了留位子的时间
choices.pinyin: Dào de shíhòu yǐjīng guò le liú wèizi de shíjiān.
choices.english: When they arrived, the time their table was held had passed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 今天七夕，餐廳不讓人訂位
choices.simplified: 今天七夕，餐厅不让人订位
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān Qīxī, cāntīng bú ràng rén dìngwèi.
choices.english: Being Qixi, the restaurant takes no bookings today.

questions.why: A booking is held for ten minutes and they came fifteen minutes late, so their booking lapsed and they are seated 按照 arrival time, behind five groups who got there first. When the others booked never comes up; they booked for seven (eight is when the others leave); and bookings are taken, just held only ten minutes.

focus.en: in accordance with; applying a rule

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼不在這家餐廳等了？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么不在这家餐厅等了？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme bú zài zhè jiā cāntīng děng le?
prompt.english: Why do they stop waiting at this restaurant?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等位子吃飯會趕不上電影
choices.simplified: 等位子吃饭会赶不上电影
choices.pinyin: Děng wèizi chīfàn huì gǎn bú shàng diànyǐng.
choices.english: Waiting for a table to eat would make them miss the movie.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de mǎi huā mǎi le tài jiǔ.
choices.english: The man took too long buying flowers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的比較想吃夜市小吃
choices.simplified: 女的比较想吃夜市小吃
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de bǐjiào xiǎng chī yèshì xiǎochī.
choices.english: The woman would rather eat night-market snacks.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bā diǎn de diànyǐng kuài kāishǐ le.
choices.english: The eight o'clock movie is about to start.

questions.why: Put the lines together: a table frees up around eight, a meal there takes up to an hour and a half, and the movie is at nine, so 再等下去 means missing it. The flowers are why they were late, not why they leave; the night market is his idea for afterwards; and the movie is at nine, not eight.

focus.zh: V 下去；兩句合起來看
focus.en: keep on doing; combining two turns

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後說「這些花你自己拿著」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后说「这些花你自己拿着」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu shuō "zhèxiē huā nǐ zìjǐ názhe", shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean when she finally says "you can carry these flowers yourself"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得那些花買得不好看
choices.simplified: 她觉得那些花买得不好看
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde nàxiē huā mǎi de bù hǎokàn.
choices.english: She thinks the flowers he bought aren't pretty.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她怕在夜市把花弄壞了
choices.simplified: 她怕在夜市把花弄坏了
choices.pinyin: Tā pà zài yèshì bǎ huā nòng huài le.
choices.english: She is afraid of damaging the flowers at the market.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她想讓他把花送給別人
choices.simplified: 她想让他把花送给别人
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng ràng tā bǎ huā sòng gěi biérén.
choices.english: She wants him to give the flowers to someone else.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她還在為晚到的事生他的氣
choices.simplified: 她还在为晚到的事生他的气
choices.pinyin: Tā hái zài wèi wǎn dào de shì shēng tā de qì.
choices.english: She is still cross with him about being late.

questions.why: She already blamed him: 都是你，在路上買花買那麼久, and the flowers are what made them late. Agreeing to his plan with 好吧, then 不過 refusing to carry them, shows she is still annoyed. She never comments on how the flowers look, and nothing points to damage or to giving them away.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an introduction, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位朋友好，歡迎來看「牛郎與織女」畫展。
lines.simplified: 各位朋友好，欢迎来看「牛郎与织女」画展。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi péngyǒu hǎo, huānyíng lái kàn "Niúláng yǔ Zhīnǚ" huàzhǎn.

lines.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de sānshí zhāng huà, dōu shì gēnjù Niúláng hé Zhīnǚ de gùshì huà de.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有的畫牛郎第一眼看到織女，有的畫王母娘娘變出一條銀河，讓兩個人只能遠遠地看著對方。

passage.traditional: 我奶奶很會做衣服。{1}她的說法，以前的姑娘在七夕都會親手做一些小東西拜織女。奶奶小時候家裡很窮，連一塊新布都買不起，{2}買新衣服了，所以她每年七夕都按照這個習俗，用舊衣服的布做一個小布包。結婚以後，她改成每年送爺爺一件親手做的衣服。{3}爺爺已經去世三年了，她還是年年做，還說要一直做{4}。今年這件她做得特別慢，我問了才知道，{5}她的眼睛不太好了。以前做好的衣服，她都收在箱子裡。{6}今年這件，她說要送給我爸爸穿，因為爸爸長得最像爺爺。
passage.simplified: 我奶奶很会做衣服。{1}她的说法，以前的姑娘在七夕都会亲手做一些小东西拜织女。奶奶小时候家里很穷，连一块新布都买不起，{2}买新衣服了，所以她每年七夕都按照这个习俗，用旧衣服的布做一个小布包。结婚以后，她改成每年送爷爷一件亲手做的衣服。{3}爷爷已经去世三年了，她还是年年做，还说要一直做{4}。今年这件她做得特别慢，我问了才知道，{5}她的眼睛不太好了。以前做好的衣服，她都收在箱子里。{6}今年这件，她说要送给我爸爸穿，因为爸爸长得最像爷爷。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai hěn huì zuò yīfu. Gēnjù tā de shuōfǎ, yǐqián de gūniáng zài Qīxī dōu huì qīnshǒu zuò yìxiē xiǎo dōngxi bài Zhīnǚ. Nǎinai xiǎo shíhòu jiālǐ hěn qióng, lián yí kuài xīn bù dōu mǎi bù qǐ, gèng bié shuō mǎi xīn yīfu le, suǒyǐ tā měi nián Qīxī dōu ànzhào zhège xísú, yòng jiù yīfu de bù zuò yí ge xiǎo bù bāo. Jiéhūn yǐhòu, tā gǎi chéng měi nián sòng yéye yí jiàn qīnshǒu zuò de yīfu. Jǐnguǎn yéye yǐjīng qùshì sān nián le, tā háishì niánnián zuò, hái shuō yào yìzhí zuò xiàqù. Jīnnián zhè jiàn tā zuò de tèbié màn, wǒ wèn le cái zhīdào, yuánlái tā de yǎnjīng bú tài hǎo le. Yǐqián zuò hǎo de yīfu, tā dōu shōu zài xiāngzi lǐ. Zhìyú jīnnián zhè jiàn, tā shuō yào sòng gěi wǒ bàba chuān, yīnwèi bàba zhǎng de zuì xiàng yéye.
passage.english: My grandma is very good at making clothes. According to her, girls in the old days would make little things by hand on Qixi to worship the Weaving Maid. Grandma's family was poor when she was little: they couldn't even afford a piece of new cloth, let alone new clothes, so every Qixi she followed this custom and made a small bag from the cloth of old clothes. After she married, she switched to giving Grandpa a piece of clothing she had made herself every year. Even though Grandpa died three years ago, she still makes one every year, and says she will keep on doing it. This year's piece is taking her especially long; only when I asked did I learn that her eyes aren't so good any more. The clothes she made before are all kept in a box. As for this year's, she says she will give to my dad to wear, because Dad looks most like Grandpa.

passage.english: According to an online survey, more than half of Taiwan's couples spend over NT$3,000 on gifts for Valentine's Day. My girlfriend and I, though, never buy any, and to explain that I have to start with our first Valentine's Day. That year I spent a lot on a designer handbag, thinking she would be delighted; instead she got angry and said we were both still students and shouldn't spend money like that. From then on we agreed that whether it's Valentine's Day or a birthday, we only give things we make ourselves. We learned to make cards and cakes online. At first they didn't look good, but later they got better and better. Last year her cake was especially good; no wonder even my mom wanted to learn from her. I think that even if a gift isn't expensive, it can still show how you feel.

text.traditional: 我爺爺和奶奶結婚五十年了。問他們是怎麼認識的，奶奶總是笑著說：「這就要從一封寫錯地址的信說起了。」五十多年前，爺爺在南部當老師，常常寫信給住在臺北的哥哥。有一次他把地址寫錯了，信就寄到了奶奶家。奶奶看信封上的字寫得很漂亮，就按照信封後面寫的地址回了一封信，告訴他信寄錯了。爺爺很不好意思，又寫了一封信來道歉。就這樣，兩個人寫了一年的信，才第一次見面。那時候沒有手機，也沒有網路，一封信要三四天才寄得到。爺爺說，有時候等信等得很著急，好幾次都不想再寫下去了，可是一收到奶奶的信，又什麼都忘了。後來爺爺搬到臺北工作，兩個人就結婚了。去年我女朋友去美國念書，我們每天都能在網路上聊天，可是我還是常常很想她，覺得日子過得很慢。奶奶知道以後跟我說：「距離不是問題，最重要的是真心。」
text.simplified: 我爷爷和奶奶结婚五十年了。问他们是怎么认识的，奶奶总是笑着说：「这就要从一封写错地址的信说起了。」五十多年前，爷爷在南部当老师，常常写信给住在台北的哥哥。有一次他把地址写错了，信就寄到了奶奶家。奶奶看信封上的字写得很漂亮，就按照信封后面写的地址回了一封信，告诉他信寄错了。爷爷很不好意思，又写了一封信来道歉。就这样，两个人写了一年的信，才第一次见面。那时候没有手机，也没有网路，一封信要三四天才寄得到。爷爷说，有时候等信等得很着急，好几次都不想再写下去了，可是一收到奶奶的信，又什么都忘了。后来爷爷搬到台北工作，两个人就结婚了。去年我女朋友去美国念书，我们每天都能在网路上聊天，可是我还是常常很想她，觉得日子过得很慢。奶奶知道以后跟我说：「距离不是问题，最重要的是真心。」
text.pinyin: Wǒ yéye hé nǎinai jiéhūn wǔshí nián le. Wèn tāmen shì zěnme rènshì de, nǎinai zǒngshì xiàozhe shuō: "Zhè jiù yào cóng yì fēng xiě cuò dìzhǐ de xìn shuō qǐ le." Wǔshí duō nián qián, yéye zài nánbù dāng lǎoshī, chángcháng xiě xìn gěi zhù zài Táiběi de gēge. Yǒu yí cì tā bǎ dìzhǐ xiě cuò le, xìn jiù jì dào le nǎinai jiā. Nǎinai kàn xìnfēng shàng de zì xiě de hěn piàoliang, jiù ànzhào xìnfēng hòumiàn xiě de dìzhǐ huí le yì fēng xìn, gàosu tā xìn jì cuò le. Yéye hěn bù hǎo yìsi, yòu xiě le yì fēng xìn lái dàoqiàn. Jiù zhèyàng, liǎng ge rén xiě le yì nián de xìn, cái dì yī cì jiànmiàn. Nà shíhòu méiyǒu shǒujī, yě méiyǒu wǎnglù, yì fēng xìn yào sān sì tiān cái jì de dào. Yéye shuō, yǒu shíhòu děng xìn děng de hěn zhāojí, hǎojǐ cì dōu bù xiǎng zài xiě xiàqù le, kěshì yì shōu dào nǎinai de xìn, yòu shénme dōu wàng le. Hòulái yéye bān dào Táiběi gōngzuò, liǎng ge rén jiù jiéhūn le. Qùnián wǒ nǚpéngyǒu qù Měiguó niànshū, wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng zài wǎnglù shàng liáotiān, kěshì wǒ háishì chángcháng hěn xiǎng tā, juéde rìzi guò de hěn màn. Nǎinai zhīdào yǐhòu gēn wǒ shuō: "Jùlí bú shì wèntí, zuì zhòngyào de shì zhēnxīn."
text.english: My grandparents have been married for fifty years. Ask them how they met, and Grandma always laughs: "For that, we have to start with a letter sent to the wrong address." Over fifty years ago Grandpa was a teacher in the south and often wrote to his older brother in Taipei. Once he got the address wrong, and the letter went to Grandma's home. Seeing how beautiful the handwriting on the envelope was, Grandma wrote back to the address on the back of the envelope to tell him the letter had gone astray. Grandpa was embarrassed and wrote again to apologise. And so the two wrote to each other for a year before they first met. There were no mobile phones then, and no internet; a letter took three or four days to arrive. Grandpa says that sometimes waiting for a letter made him so anxious that several times he wanted to stop writing, but as soon as Grandma's letter arrived, he forgot all of it. Later Grandpa moved to Taipei for work, and the two got married. Last year my girlfriend went to study in America. We can chat online every day, but I still miss her a lot and the days feel slow. When Grandma heard, she told me: "Distance isn't the problem. What matters most is sincerity."

choices.simplified: 等信时不想再写的心情
choices.pinyin: Děng xìn shí bù xiǎng zài xiě de xīnqíng.

questions.why: 什麼都忘了 points back to the same sentence: waiting made him anxious and several times he 不想再寫下去, but a letter from her wiped that out. The wrong address and his brother come at the start of the story, and the three or four days are a fact that did not change; it was his low mood that went away.

questions.why: She answers his missing his girlfriend with her own story: she and Grandpa lasted on slow letters, so 距離不是問題，最重要的是真心. She never tells him to write letters or rates letters above chat, and she says distance is fine, not that the girlfriend should return.

title.pinyin: Xìjù shè de yí cì yǎnchū
title.english: One Performance by the Drama Club

text.traditional: 我們學校的戲劇社每年秋天都有一次演出，今年大家選了牛郎和織女的故事。可是要怎麼演，大家的看法很不一樣。有人覺得應該按照原來的故事演，兩個人一年只能見一次面，觀眾才會感動；也有人說，現在的觀眾不愛看讓人難過的結局，應該讓他們團圓。大家討論了兩個星期，還是決定不了。最後負責的同學想了一個辦法：在網路上做調查，根據調查的結果來決定，大家都同意了。調查做完，有百分之七十的人選了團圓。演出那天來了兩百多位觀眾。前面我們都按照原來的故事演，到了最後，王母娘娘被織女的眼淚感動，讓他們一家人住在一起。演完以後，有一位老太太來找我們。她說她一生看過很多次牛郎織女的戲，這是第一次看到這樣的結局。雖然跟她知道的不一樣，可是她很喜歡。她笑著說：「故事是人寫的，人當然可以改。」
text.simplified: 我们学校的戏剧社每年秋天都有一次演出，今年大家选了牛郎和织女的故事。可是要怎么演，大家的看法很不一样。有人觉得应该按照原来的故事演，两个人一年只能见一次面，观众才会感动；也有人说，现在的观众不爱看让人难过的结局，应该让他们团圆。大家讨论了两个星期，还是决定不了。最后负责的同学想了一个办法：在网路上做调查，根据调查的结果来决定，大家都同意了。调查做完，有百分之七十的人选了团圆。演出那天来了两百多位观众。前面我们都按照原来的故事演，到了最后，王母娘娘被织女的眼泪感动，让他们一家人住在一起。演完以后，有一位老太太来找我们。她说她一生看过很多次牛郎织女的戏，这是第一次看到这样的结局。虽然跟她知道的不一样，可是她很喜欢。她笑着说：「故事是人写的，人当然可以改。」
text.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de xìjù shè měi nián qiūtiān dōu yǒu yí cì yǎnchū, jīnnián dàjiā xuǎn le Niúláng hé Zhīnǚ de gùshì. Kěshì yào zěnme yǎn, dàjiā de kànfǎ hěn bù yíyàng. Yǒu rén juéde yīnggāi ànzhào yuánlái de gùshì yǎn, liǎng ge rén yì nián zhǐ néng jiàn yí cì miàn, guānzhòng cái huì gǎndòng; yě yǒu rén shuō, xiànzài de guānzhòng bú ài kàn ràng rén nánguò de jiéjú, yīnggāi ràng tāmen tuányuán. Dàjiā tǎolùn le liǎng ge xīngqí, háishì juédìng bù liǎo. Zuìhòu fùzé de tóngxué xiǎng le yí ge bànfǎ: zài wǎnglù shàng zuò diàochá, gēnjù diàochá de jiéguǒ lái juédìng, dàjiā dōu tóngyì le. Diàochá zuò wán, yǒu bǎi fēn zhī qīshí de rén xuǎn le tuányuán. Yǎnchū nà tiān lái le liǎngbǎi duō wèi guānzhòng. Qiánmiàn wǒmen dōu ànzhào yuánlái de gùshì yǎn, dào le zuìhòu, Wángmǔ Niángniang bèi Zhīnǚ de yǎnlèi gǎndòng, ràng tāmen yì jiā rén zhù zài yìqǐ. Yǎn wán yǐhòu, yǒu yí wèi lǎo tàitai lái zhǎo wǒmen. Tā shuō tā yìshēng kàn guo hěn duō cì Niúláng Zhīnǚ de xì, zhè shì dì yī cì kàndào zhèyàng de jiéjú. Suīrán gēn tā zhīdào de bù yíyàng, kěshì tā hěn xǐhuān. Tā xiàozhe shuō: "Gùshì shì rén xiě de, rén dāngrán kěyǐ gǎi."
text.english: Our school drama club puts on a show every autumn, and this year everyone chose the story of the Cowherd and the Weaving Maid. But people had very different views on how to stage it. Some felt we should follow the original story, with the two allowed to meet only once a year, because only then would the audience be moved; others said today's audiences don't like sad endings, so we should reunite them. We argued for two weeks and still couldn't decide. In the end the student in charge came up with a way: run a survey online and decide by its results, and everyone agreed. When the survey was done, seventy percent had chosen the reunion. More than two hundred people came on the night. We followed the original story for most of the play, but at the end the Queen Mother was moved by the Weaving Maid's tears and let the family live together. Afterwards an elderly lady came to find us. She said she had seen the Cowherd and Weaving Maid play many times in her life, and this was the first time she had seen an ending like this. Although it was different from the one she knew, she loved it. She laughed and said, "People wrote the story, so of course people can change it."

questions.why: They ran a survey online and decided 根據調查的結果, and 70% chose the reunion. The student in charge only suggested the method; the original story was kept for most of the play but not the ending; and the audience spoke after the show, when the ending was already set.

choices.english: The plays she saw before were all done wrong.

questions.why: 故事是人寫的，人當然可以改 defends changing the story: an ending does not have to stay as it was. She says nothing about stories being true or false, she likes the new ending without calling it better, and she does not say the old plays were wrong, only that this one was different.

questions.why: Every paragraph serves one line: the argument over the ending, the survey that settled it, the show and the lady who liked it. Moving people by keeping the original is only one side of the argument, one lady is not all older viewers, and the survey is one step, not the point.
